note: [F] Deicyde/diophantine-z-q, proved; ZInQ.Size.E0sub a definition: [F] proves, rather than cites, the part of Silverman VII.2.1 that [M] uses: for y^2 = x^3 + Ax over the localization of Z[s] at a prime pi not dividing 2, reduction is a homomorphism from W0(pi) to the nonsingular reduced points with kernel W1(pi), so the reduced point's order sends Q into W1(pi). It is specialized to these curves and global localizations and omits the surjectivity in Silverman's exact sequence, which [M] does not use; the standing is proved without hypotheses.

def E0sub : AddSubgroup (shortCurve A).toAffine.Point where
  carrier := {P | InE0 π ρ A Ab P}
  zero_mem' := trivial
  add_mem' hP hQ :=
    (inE0_add_redK_add hπ ρ hρ hA hAb (two_ne_zero_of_not_dvd ρ hρ h2) hP hQ).1
  neg_mem' hP := inE0_neg hπ ρ hρ hA hP
